links.comparator_used: AI score presented alone or with an abnormality cutoff threshold only, without error-rate information (FDR/FOR)
links.outcome: Intention to consult an attorney for litigation if advanced cancer were detected a year later (primary); follow-up decisions
links.effect: Providing the FDR/FOR reduced litigation, with similar effects on follow-up behaviors; no numeric estimates are given in the abstract
links.quote: Providing the FDR/FOR reduced litigation; similar effects were observed for follow-up behaviors.

links.comparator_used: AI report without false-positive/false-negative limitation information, versus AI report with both an abnormality cutoff threshold and the AI's False Discovery Rate (FDR) or False Omission Rate (FOR).
links.outcome: Litigation intention and follow-up behaviors after viewing a negative radiologist mammography report with an AI report.
links.effect: Providing the FDR/FOR reduced litigation; similar effects were observed for follow-up behaviors. n = 1623 randomized to thirteen conditions.
links.quote: Providing the FDR/FOR reduced litigation; similar effects were observed for follow-up behaviors.
